name: bobi-english-adventure
description: 波波熱血英語大冒險 (Bobi English Adventure) - 全階段・全能分級英語學習樂園 (小學・國中・高中・大學 12 等級 192 關)

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const v=pkg.version; global.window={}; require('./curriculum.js'); const d=window.CURRICULUM_DATA; const totalLessons=d.reduce((s,t)=>s+t.lessons.length,0); const html=fs.readFileSync('./index.html','utf8'); const readme=fs.readFileSync('./README.md','utf8'); const changelog=fs.readFileSync('./CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); if(window.BOBI_VERSION!==v||window.CURRICULUM_VERSION!==v) throw new Error('Version mismatch in curriculum.js'); if(!html.includes('content=\"'+v+'\"')||!html.includes('v'+v)) throw new Error('Version mismatch in index.html'); if(!readme.includes('v'+v)) throw new Error('Version mismatch in README.md'); if(!changelog.includes('['+v+']')) throw new Error('Version mismatch in CHANGELOG.md'); if(d.length!==12||totalLessons!==192) throw new Error('Curriculum count mismatch'); console.log('✅ [5-Way Version Alignment Verified] v'+v+' across package.json, curriculum.js, index.html, README.md, CHANGELOG.md'); console.log('✅ [Curriculum Verified] Loaded '+d.length+' tiers & '+totalLessons+' levels without errors!');"
